## Purpose and boundary

This notebook performs Stages 0 and 1 of the authorised D15 pilot. Stage 0 verifies the official CDF input, the frozen five-wave nine-node complete-case object, weight availability and exact case-level matching. Stage 1 implements the two prospectively approved candidates, `W_CDF` and `W_POST_COMPAT`, and reports only weight-distribution and weighted-versus-unweighted category-proportion diagnostics. It does not estimate weighted correlations or networks and does not run bootstrap, centrality, NCT, education-group analysis, formal five-wave results or political interpretation.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  error = FALSE,
  warning = TRUE,
  message = TRUE
)
```

```{r project-root}
current_dir <- normalizePath(

if (

      "ANES.Rproj"

  )
) {

} else if (
```

## Package gate

Stages 0 and 1 use only packages already locked by the existing project. They do not install or update packages.

```{r package-gate}
required_packages <- c(
  "digest",
  "haven",
  "tidyselect"
)

package_available <- vapply(
  required_packages,
  requireNamespace,
  quietly = TRUE,
  FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
)

package_gate <- data.frame(
  Package = required_packages,
  Available = unname(package_available),
  Version = vapply(
    required_packages,
    function(package_name) {
      if (requireNamespace(package_name, quietly = TRUE)) {
        as.character(
          utils::packageVersion(package_name)
        )
      } else {
        NA_character_
      }
    },
    FUN.VALUE = character(1)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

package_gate

stopifnot(
  all(package_gate$Available)
)
```

## D15 authorisation gate

The notebook reads the current decision registry. It does not accept a manually edited switch inside this file.

```{r d15-authorisation-gate}
registry_config <- file.path(
  project_root,
  "config",
  "decision_registry_path.txt"
)

stopifnot(
  file.exists(registry_config)
)

registry_lines <- trimws(
  readLines(
    registry_config,
    warn = FALSE
  )
)

registry_lines <- registry_lines[
  nzchar(registry_lines)
]

stopifnot(
  length(registry_lines) == 1L,
  file.exists(registry_lines)
)

registry_path <- normalizePath(
  registry_lines,
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

decision_registry <- utils::read.csv(
  registry_path,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

required_registry_columns <- c(
  "decision_id",
  "decision_status",
  "implementation_status",
  "researcher_approval_status",
  "analysis_effect",
  "last_verified"
)

stopifnot(
  all(
    required_registry_columns %in%
      names(decision_registry)
  )
)

normalise_status <- function(value) {
  value <- toupper(
    trimws(
      as.character(value)
    )
  )
  gsub(
    "[ -]+",
    "_",
    value
  )
}

d15 <- decision_registry[
  decision_registry$decision_id == "D15",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

d15_authorised <-
  nrow(d15) == 1L &&
  normalise_status(d15$decision_status) ==
    "PILOT_AUTHORISED" &&
  normalise_status(d15$implementation_status) ==
    "STAGE0_COMPLETE_STAGE1_AUTHORISED" &&
  normalise_status(d15$researcher_approval_status) ==
    "APPROVED_FOR_BOUNDED_PILOT_ONLY" &&
  normalise_status(d15$analysis_effect) ==
    "BLOCKS_CORE_GGM"

d15_gate <- data.frame(
  Registry = registry_path,
  D15_rows = nrow(d15),
  Decision_status = if (nrow(d15) == 1L) {
    d15$decision_status
  } else {
    NA_character_
  },
  Implementation_status = if (nrow(d15) == 1L) {
    d15$implementation_status
  } else {
    NA_character_
  },
  Researcher_approval = if (nrow(d15) == 1L) {
    d15$researcher_approval_status
  } else {
    NA_character_
  },
  Core_GGM_still_blocked = if (nrow(d15) == 1L) {
    normalise_status(d15$analysis_effect) ==
      "BLOCKS_CORE_GGM"
  } else {
    NA
  },
  D15_pilot_authorised = d15_authorised,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

d15_gate

stopifnot(
  d15_authorised
)
```

## Input paths and immutable-input gates

```{r input-paths-and-hashes}
cdf_path_config <- file.path(

)

analysis_ready_file <- file.path(

  "analysis_ready",

    "anes_cdf_20260205_analysis_ready_nine_node_",
    "complete_case_2004_2012_2016_2020_2024.rds"
  )
)

stopifnot(
  file.exists(cdf_path_config),
  file.exists(analysis_ready_file)
)

cdf_path_lines <- trimws(
  readLines(
    cdf_path_config,
    warn = FALSE
  )
)

cdf_path_lines <- cdf_path_lines[
  nzchar(cdf_path_lines)
]

stopifnot(
  length(cdf_path_lines) == 1L,
  file.exists(cdf_path_lines)
)

cdf_file <- normalizePath(
  cdf_path_lines,
  winslash = "/",
  mustWork = TRUE
)

expected_cdf_sha256 <-
  "45323c30faee1e9e67c2351c4302c31472b117050bef240d9339a264e2f3e078"

expected_analysis_ready_object_sha256 <-
  "78e5c1cff278a6640834113b769ef4251807ab30659b6effcfd6a14db58ada6c"

cdf_file_sha256 <- digest::digest(
  file = cdf_file,
  algo = "sha256",

)

anes_analysis_ready <- readRDS(
  analysis_ready_file
)

analysis_ready_file_sha256 <- digest::digest(
  file = analysis_ready_file,
  algo = "sha256",
  serialize = FALSE
)

analysis_ready_object_sha256 <- digest::digest(
  anes_analysis_ready,
  algo = "sha256",

)

input_identity_gate <- data.frame(
  Input = c(
    "Official CDF Stata file",
    "Frozen analysis-ready RDS file",

  ),
  Observed_SHA256 = c(
    cdf_file_sha256,

    analysis_ready_object_sha256
  ),
  Expected_SHA256 = c(
    expected_cdf_sha256,
    NA_character_,

      cdf_file_sha256,

      expected_analysis_ready_object_sha256
    )
  ),

)

input_identity_gate

stopifnot(
  all(input_identity_gate$Passed)
)
```

```{r frozen-sample-gate}
expected_years <- c(

expected_year_counts <- c(
  "2004" = 789L,
  "2012" = 4353L,
  "2016" = 2709L,
  "2020" = 5390L,

)

network_vars <- c(
  "VCF0806",
  "VCF0809",
  "VCF0838",
  "VCF0839",
  "VCF0879a",
  "VCF0888",
  "VCF0890",

required_analysis_ready_vars <- c(

sample_gate <- data.frame(
```

## Read only the required weight fields from the official CDF

The original CDF is read but never modified. `VCF9999` is joined in memory only for this pilot.

```{r read-official-weight-fields}
raw_weight_vars <- c(
  "VCF0004",
  "VCF0006",
  "VCF0006a",
  "VCF0009z",
  "VCF9999"
)

anes_weight_source <- haven::read_dta(
  cdf_file,
  col_select = tidyselect::all_of(
    raw_weight_vars
  )
)

stopifnot(
  identical(
    names(anes_weight_source),
    raw_weight_vars
  )
)

raw_variable_metadata <- data.frame(
  Variable = raw_weight_vars,
  Stata_label = vapply(
    raw_weight_vars,
    function(variable_name) {
      variable_label <- attr(
        anes_weight_source[[variable_name]],
        "label"
      )
      if (is.null(variable_label)) {
        NA_character_
      } else {
        as.character(variable_label)
      }
    },
    FUN.VALUE = character(1)
  ),
  Class = vapply(
    raw_weight_vars,
    function(variable_name) {
      paste(
        class(
          anes_weight_source[[variable_name]]
        ),
        collapse = ";"
      )
    },
    FUN.VALUE = character(1)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

raw_variable_metadata
```

## Exact complete-case membership match

```{r exact-case-match}
source_in_scope <- anes_weight_source[
  anes_weight_source$VCF0004 %in%
    expected_years,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

source_key <- as.numeric(
  source_in_scope$VCF0006a
)

analysis_key <- as.numeric(
  anes_analysis_ready$VCF0006a
)

source_duplicate_keys <- sum(
  duplicated(source_key)
)

analysis_duplicate_keys <- sum(
  duplicated(analysis_key)
)

match_index <- match(
  analysis_key,
  source_key
)

unmatched_analysis_cases <- sum(
  is.na(match_index)
)

match_gate <- data.frame(
  Check = c(
    "No duplicate VCF0006a cross-year IDs in official source",
    "No duplicate VCF0006a cross-year IDs in analysis-ready data",
    "Every analysis-ready case matches the official source"
  ),
  Observed = c(
    source_duplicate_keys,
    analysis_duplicate_keys,
    unmatched_analysis_cases
  ),
  Expected = c(
    0L,
    0L,
    0L
  ),
  Passed = c(
    source_duplicate_keys == 0L,
    analysis_duplicate_keys == 0L,
    unmatched_analysis_cases == 0L
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

match_gate

stopifnot(
  all(match_gate$Passed)
)

pilot_weight_data <- anes_analysis_ready

pilot_weight_data$VCF0009z_source <- as.numeric(
  source_in_scope$VCF0009z[
    match_index
  ]
)

pilot_weight_data$VCF9999_source <- as.numeric(
  source_in_scope$VCF9999[
    match_index
  ]
)

vcf0009z_absolute_difference <- abs(
  as.numeric(
    pilot_weight_data$VCF0009z
  ) -
    pilot_weight_data$VCF0009z_source
)

vcf0009z_match_gate <- data.frame(
  Matched_cases = nrow(pilot_weight_data),
  Exact_matches = sum(
    vcf0009z_absolute_difference == 0,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  Missing_comparisons = sum(
    is.na(vcf0009z_absolute_difference)
  ),
  Maximum_absolute_difference = max(
    vcf0009z_absolute_difference,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  Passed = all(
    !is.na(vcf0009z_absolute_difference) &
      vcf0009z_absolute_difference == 0
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

vcf0009z_match_gate

stopifnot(
  vcf0009z_match_gate$Passed
)
```

## Official source map and observed availability

The source-variable map below is transcribed from the official February 2026 CDF variable codebook. `NO CDF SOURCE LISTED` is retained explicitly for 2012 `VCF9999`.

```{r source-map-and-availability}
source_map <- data.frame(
  Election_year = rep(
    expected_years,
    times = 2L
  ),
  Weight_variable = rep(
    c(
      "VCF0009z",
      "VCF9999"
    ),
    each = length(expected_years)
  ),
  Official_role = c(
    rep(
      "CDF full-sample weight",
      length(expected_years)
    ),
    rep(
      "CDF post-election full-sample weight",
      length(expected_years)
    )
  ),
  Official_source_variable = c(
    "V040101",
    "weight_full",
    "V160101",
    "V200010a",
    "V240107a",
    "V040102",
    "NO CDF SOURCE LISTED",
    "V160102",
    "V200010b",
    "V240107b"
  ),
  Source_record_status = c(
    rep(
      "VERIFIED IN OFFICIAL CDF CODEBOOK",
      length(expected_years)
    ),
    "VERIFIED IN OFFICIAL CDF CODEBOOK",
    "NO CDF SOURCE LISTED",
    rep(
      "VERIFIED IN OFFICIAL CDF CODEBOOK",
      3L
    )
  ),
  Official_document = rep(
    paste0(
      "ANES Time Series Cumulative Data File ",
      "Variable Codebook, 2026-02-05"
    ),
    length(expected_years) * 2L
  ),
  Official_url = rep(
    paste0(
      "https://electionstudies.org/wp-content/uploads/",
      "2026/02/anes_timeseries_cdf_codebook_var_20260205.pdf"
    ),
    length(expected_years) * 2L
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

summarise_weight_availability <- function(
  data,
  variable_name
) {
  do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(
      expected_years,
      function(year_value) {
        year_rows <- as.integer(
          data$VCF0004
        ) == year_value

        weight_values <- as.numeric(
          data[[variable_name]][
            year_rows
          ]
        )

        nonmissing_values <- weight_values[
          !is.na(weight_values)
        ]

        finite_values <- nonmissing_values[
          is.finite(nonmissing_values)
        ]

        data.frame(
          Election_year = year_value,
          Weight_variable = sub(
            "_source$",
            "",
            variable_name
          ),
          Analysis_ready_N = length(weight_values),
          Missing_N = sum(
            is.na(weight_values)
          ),
          Nonfinite_nonmissing_N = sum(
            !is.finite(nonmissing_values)
          ),
          Nonpositive_finite_N = sum(
            finite_values <= 0
          ),
          Positive_finite_N = sum(
            finite_values > 0
          ),
          Minimum_positive = if (
            any(finite_values > 0)
          ) {
            min(
              finite_values[
                finite_values > 0
              ]
            )
          } else {
            NA_real_
          },
          Maximum_positive = if (
            any(finite_values > 0)
          ) {
            max(
              finite_values[
                finite_values > 0
              ]
            )
          } else {
            NA_real_
          },
          All_complete_cases_have_positive_weight =
            length(weight_values) > 0L &&
            all(
              !is.na(weight_values) &
                is.finite(weight_values) &
                weight_values > 0
            ),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    )
  )
}

observed_availability <- rbind(
  summarise_weight_availability(
    pilot_weight_data,
    "VCF0009z_source"
  ),
  summarise_weight_availability(
    pilot_weight_data,
    "VCF9999_source"
  )
)

source_map_key <- paste(
  source_map$Election_year,
  source_map$Weight_variable,
  sep = "::"
)

availability_key <- paste(
  observed_availability$Election_year,
  observed_availability$Weight_variable,
  sep = "::"
)

source_match <- match(
  source_map_key,
  availability_key
)

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(source_match)
)

d15_weight_source_audit <- cbind(
  source_map,
  observed_availability[
    source_match,
    setdiff(
      names(observed_availability),
      c(
        "Election_year",
        "Weight_variable"
      )
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)

d15_weight_source_audit$Present_in_analysis_ready_RDS <-
  d15_weight_source_audit$Weight_variable %in%
  names(anes_analysis_ready)

d15_weight_source_audit$Stage_1_status <- ifelse(
  d15_weight_source_audit$All_complete_cases_have_positive_weight,
  "TECHNICALLY AVAILABLE FOR COMPLETE-CASE PILOT",
  ifelse(
    d15_weight_source_audit$Weight_variable == "VCF9999" &
      d15_weight_source_audit$Election_year == 2012L,
    "2012 FALLBACK DECISION REQUIRED BEFORE STAGE 1",
    "NOT TECHNICALLY AVAILABLE"
  )
)

d15_weight_source_audit
```

```{r stage0-result}
stage0_result <- data.frame(
  Check = c(
    "Official CDF identity confirmed",
    "Frozen analysis-ready object confirmed",

    "Stored VCF0009z reproduced exactly from the official CDF",

    "VCF9999 positive for all complete cases in 2004 2016 2020 2024",
```

## Stage 1 approval and candidate construction

Stage 0 has been independently reviewed. The researcher prospectively approved two candidates on 2026-08-29:

- `W_CDF`: `VCF0009z` in every wave;
- `W_POST_COMPAT`: `VCF9999` in 2004, 2016, 2020 and 2024, with official `VCF0009z` (`weight_full`) as an explicitly labelled wave-specific substitute in 2012.

This approval does not freeze D15 and does not permit choosing a candidate from political or network results.

```{r stage1-candidate-construction}
stage0_required_checks <- c(
  "Official CDF identity confirmed",
  "Frozen analysis-ready object confirmed",
  "All 16766 complete cases matched to the official CDF",
  "Stored VCF0009z reproduced exactly from the official CDF",
  "VCF0009z positive for all complete cases in all five waves",
  "VCF9999 positive for all complete cases in 2004 2016 2020 2024"
)

stopifnot(
  all(
    stage0_result$Passed[
      match(
        stage0_required_checks,
        stage0_result$Check
      )
    ]
  )
)

stage1_data <- pilot_weight_data

stage1_data$W_CDF <- as.numeric(
  stage1_data$VCF0009z_source
)

stage1_data$W_POST_COMPAT <- ifelse(
  as.integer(stage1_data$VCF0004) == 2012L,
  as.numeric(stage1_data$VCF0009z_source),
  as.numeric(stage1_data$VCF9999_source)
)

candidate_map <- data.frame(
  Candidate = rep(
    c("W_CDF", "W_POST_COMPAT"),
    each = length(expected_years)
  ),
  Election_year = rep(
    expected_years,
    times = 2L
  ),
  CDF_weight_variable = c(
    rep("VCF0009z", length(expected_years)),
    "VCF9999",
    "VCF0009z",
    "VCF9999",
    "VCF9999",
    "VCF9999"
  ),
  Official_source_variable = c(
    "V040101",
    "weight_full",
    "V160101",
    "V200010a",
    "V240107a",
    "V040102",
    "weight_full",
    "V160102",
    "V200010b",
    "V240107b"
  ),
  Candidate_role = c(
    rep(
      "Uniform five-wave CDF full-sample-weight candidate",
      length(expected_years)
    ),
    "Post-election full-sample weight",
    paste0(
      "Wave-specific official 2012 substitute: ",
      "CDF full-sample weight"
    ),
    rep(
      "Post-election full-sample weight",
      3L
    )
  ),
  Rescaling_applied = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

candidate_map

candidate_values_are_valid <- vapply(
  c("W_CDF", "W_POST_COMPAT"),
  function(candidate_name) {
    candidate_values <- stage1_data[[candidate_name]]
    all(
      !is.na(candidate_values) &
        is.finite(candidate_values) &
        candidate_values > 0
    )
  },
  FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
)

stopifnot(
  all(candidate_values_are_valid)
)
```

## Stage 1 weight-distribution audit

Kish effective sample size is used only as a diagnostic of weight dispersion. It is not substituted for model `N` in this stage.

```{r stage1-weight-distribution-audit}
safe_quantile <- function(values, probability) {
  as.numeric(
    stats::quantile(
      values,
      probs = probability,
      names = FALSE,
      type = 7
    )
  )
}

summarise_weight_distribution <- function(
  data,
  candidate_name,
  year_value
) {
  year_rows <- as.integer(data$VCF0004) == year_value
  weights <- as.numeric(
    data[[candidate_name]][year_rows]
  )

  valid_weights <- weights[
    !is.na(weights) &
      is.finite(weights) &
      weights > 0
  ]

  kish_ess <- if (length(valid_weights) > 0L) {
    sum(valid_weights)^2 / sum(valid_weights^2)
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  data.frame(
    Candidate = candidate_name,
    Election_year = year_value,
    Complete_case_N = length(weights),
    Missing_N = sum(is.na(weights)),
    Nonfinite_nonmissing_N = sum(
      !is.na(weights) & !is.finite(weights)
    ),
    Nonpositive_finite_N = sum(
      !is.na(weights) &
        is.finite(weights) &
        weights <= 0
    ),
    Valid_positive_N = length(valid_weights),
    Minimum = min(valid_weights),
    P01 = safe_quantile(valid_weights, 0.01),
    P05 = safe_quantile(valid_weights, 0.05),
    Median = stats::median(valid_weights),
    Mean = mean(valid_weights),
    P95 = safe_quantile(valid_weights, 0.95),
    P99 = safe_quantile(valid_weights, 0.99),
    Maximum = max(valid_weights),
    Standard_deviation = stats::sd(valid_weights),
    Coefficient_of_variation =
      stats::sd(valid_weights) / mean(valid_weights),
    Sum_of_weights = sum(valid_weights),
    Kish_effective_N = kish_ess,
    Kish_ESS_over_N = kish_ess / length(weights),
    Maximum_over_median =
      max(valid_weights) / stats::median(valid_weights),
    Rescaling_applied = FALSE,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

d15_weight_distribution_audit <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    c("W_CDF", "W_POST_COMPAT"),
    function(candidate_name) {
      do.call(
        rbind,
        lapply(
          expected_years,
          function(year_value) {
            summarise_weight_distribution(
              stage1_data,
              candidate_name,
              year_value
            )
          }
        )
      )
    }
  )
)

distribution_map_key <- paste(
  d15_weight_distribution_audit$Candidate,
  d15_weight_distribution_audit$Election_year,
  sep = "::"
)

candidate_map_key <- paste(
  candidate_map$Candidate,
  candidate_map$Election_year,
  sep = "::"
)

distribution_map_match <- match(
  distribution_map_key,
  candidate_map_key
)

stopifnot(
  !anyNA(distribution_map_match)
)

d15_weight_distribution_audit <- cbind(
  d15_weight_distribution_audit,
  candidate_map[
    distribution_map_match,
    c(
      "CDF_weight_variable",
      "Official_source_variable",
      "Candidate_role"
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
)

d15_weight_distribution_audit
```

## Stage 1 weighted and unweighted category proportions

The calculation retains the observed ordered categories. It does not collapse, relabel or recode a node.

```{r stage1-category-proportions}
ordered_category_labels <- function(values) {
  if (is.factor(values)) {
    as.character(levels(values))
  } else {
    unique_values <- unique(values)
    unique_values <- unique_values[!is.na(unique_values)]
    as.character(sort(unique_values))
  }
}

summarise_node_proportions <- function(
  data,
  candidate_name,
  year_value,
  node_name
) {
  year_rows <- as.integer(data$VCF0004) == year_value
  node_values <- data[[node_name]][year_rows]
  weights <- as.numeric(
    data[[candidate_name]][year_rows]
  )

  category_labels <- ordered_category_labels(node_values)

  do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(
      seq_along(category_labels),
      function(category_index) {
        category_label <- category_labels[[category_index]]
        in_category <- as.character(node_values) == category_label

        unweighted_proportion <- mean(in_category)
        weighted_proportion <-
          sum(weights[in_category]) / sum(weights)

        data.frame(
          Candidate = candidate_name,
          Election_year = year_value,
          Node = node_name,
          Category_order = category_index,
          Category_value = category_label,
          Complete_case_N = length(node_values),
          Category_N = sum(in_category),
          Unweighted_proportion = unweighted_proportion,
          Weighted_proportion = weighted_proportion,
          Difference_percentage_points =
            100 * (
              weighted_proportion -
                unweighted_proportion
            ),
          Absolute_difference_percentage_points =
            100 * abs(
              weighted_proportion -
                unweighted_proportion
            ),
          Weight_sum = sum(weights),
          Category_weight_sum = sum(weights[in_category]),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    )
  )
}

d15_weighted_category_proportions <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    c("W_CDF", "W_POST_COMPAT"),
    function(candidate_name) {
      do.call(
        rbind,
        lapply(
          expected_years,
          function(year_value) {
            do.call(
              rbind,
              lapply(
                network_vars,
                function(node_name) {
                  summarise_node_proportions(
                    stage1_data,
                    candidate_name,
                    year_value,
                    node_name
                  )
                }
              )
            )
          }
        )
      )
    }
  )
)

d15_category_shift_summary <- stats::aggregate(
  Absolute_difference_percentage_points ~
    Candidate + Election_year + Node,
  data = d15_weighted_category_proportions,
  FUN = max
)

names(d15_category_shift_summary)[
  names(d15_category_shift_summary) ==
    "Absolute_difference_percentage_points"
] <- "Maximum_absolute_difference_percentage_points"

d15_weighted_category_proportions
d15_category_shift_summary
```

## Stage 1 validation

```{r stage1-validation}
proportion_sum_check <- stats::aggregate(
  cbind(
    Unweighted_proportion,
    Weighted_proportion
  ) ~ Candidate + Election_year + Node,
  data = d15_weighted_category_proportions,
  FUN = sum
)

candidate_unweighted_check <- stats::reshape(
  d15_weighted_category_proportions[
    ,
    c(
      "Candidate",
      "Election_year",
      "Node",
      "Category_value",
      "Unweighted_proportion"
    )
  ],
  idvar = c(
    "Election_year",
    "Node",
    "Category_value"
  ),
  timevar = "Candidate",
  direction = "wide"
)

unweighted_difference <- abs(
  candidate_unweighted_check$Unweighted_proportion.W_CDF -
    candidate_unweighted_check$Unweighted_proportion.W_POST_COMPAT
)

stage1_validation <- data.frame(
  Check = c(
    "Both approved candidates contain only finite positive weights",
    "Ten wave-by-candidate weight summaries were produced",
    "All unweighted node-category proportions sum to one",
    "All weighted node-category proportions sum to one",
    "Unweighted proportions agree exactly across candidates",
    "No node value was missing in the frozen complete-case sample",
    "No correlation or network object was estimated"
  ),
  Passed = c(
    all(candidate_values_are_valid),
    nrow(d15_weight_distribution_audit) == 10L,
    all(
      abs(
        proportion_sum_check$Unweighted_proportion - 1
      ) < 1e-12
    ),
    all(
      abs(
        proportion_sum_check$Weighted_proportion - 1
      ) < 1e-12
    ),
    all(
      !is.na(unweighted_difference) &
        unweighted_difference < 1e-12
    ),
    all(
      stats::complete.cases(
        stage1_data[network_vars]
      )
    ),
    TRUE
  ),
  Consequence = c(
    "Continue",
    "Continue",
    "Continue",
    "Continue",
    "Continue",
    "Continue",
    "Hard boundary: stop before weighted polychoric estimation"
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stage1_validation

stopifnot(
  all(stage1_validation$Passed)
)
```

This gate verifies the approved software dependency and its lockfile record. It does not estimate any correlation or network.

```{r stage2a-dependency-gate}

  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  check.names = FALSE
)

  nrow(stage1_validation_from_disk) == 7L &&
  all(stage1_validation_from_disk$Passed)

  requireNamespace("lavaan", quietly = TRUE)
```

```{r stage2b-helper-functions}
make_ordered_factor <- function(values) {
  if (is.factor(values)) {
    observed_levels <- levels(
      droplevels(values)
    )

    return(
      ordered(
        as.character(values),
        levels = observed_levels
      )
    )
  }

  numeric_values <- as.numeric(values)

  ordered(
    numeric_values,
    levels = sort(
      unique(
        numeric_values[
          !is.na(numeric_values)
        ]
      )
    )
  )
}

run_and_capture <- function(calculation) {
  warning_messages <- character(0)
  ordinary_messages <- character(0)
  error_message <- NA_character_

  value <- tryCatch(
    withCallingHandlers(
      calculation(),
      warning = function(condition) {
        warning_messages <<- c(
          warning_messages,
          conditionMessage(condition)
        )
        invokeRestart("muffleWarning")
      },
      message = function(condition) {
        ordinary_messages <<- c(
          ordinary_messages,
          conditionMessage(condition)
        )
        invokeRestart("muffleMessage")
      }
    ),
    error = function(condition) {
      error_message <<- conditionMessage(condition)
      NULL
    }
  )

  list(
    value = value,
    warnings = unique(warning_messages),
    messages = unique(ordinary_messages),
    error = error_message
  )
}

collapse_conditions <- function(values) {
  if (length(values) == 0L) {
    ""
  } else {
    paste(values, collapse = " | ")
  }
}

diagnose_matrix <- function(
  matrix_object,
  candidate,
  implementation
) {
  matrix_present <-
    is.matrix(matrix_object) &&
    identical(
      dim(matrix_object),
      c(9L, 9L)
    )

  finite <- matrix_present &&
    all(is.finite(matrix_object))

  maximum_asymmetry <- if (finite) {
    max(
      abs(
        matrix_object -
          t(matrix_object)
      )
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  maximum_diagonal_difference <- if (finite) {
    max(
      abs(
        diag(matrix_object) - 1
      )
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  minimum_eigenvalue <- if (
    finite &&
    maximum_asymmetry <= 1e-10
  ) {
    tryCatch(
      min(
        eigen(
          matrix_object,
          symmetric = TRUE,
          only.values = TRUE
        )$values
      ),
      error = function(condition) {
        NA_real_
      }
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  off_diagonal <- if (finite) {
    matrix_object[
      upper.tri(matrix_object)
    ]
  } else {
    numeric(0)
  }

  data.frame(
    Election_year = stage2_year,
    Candidate = candidate,
    Implementation = implementation,
    Matrix_present = matrix_present,
    Expected_dimension = "9 x 9",
    All_values_finite = finite,
    Maximum_asymmetry = maximum_asymmetry,
    Maximum_diagonal_difference =
      maximum_diagonal_difference,
    Minimum_eigenvalue = minimum_eigenvalue,
    Positive_definite =
      !is.na(minimum_eigenvalue) &&
      minimum_eigenvalue > 0,
    Unique_off_diagonal_values =
      length(off_diagonal),
    Minimum_off_diagonal = if (
      length(off_diagonal) > 0L
    ) {
      min(off_diagonal)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    Maximum_off_diagonal = if (
      length(off_diagonal) > 0L
    ) {
      max(off_diagonal)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r stage2b-estimation}
stage2_results <- list()
stage2_condition_records <- list()
condition_index <- 1L

for (candidate_name in stage2_candidates) {
  node_data <- data.frame(
    lapply(
      stage2_data[network_vars],
      make_ordered_factor
    ),
    check.names = FALSE
  )

  names(node_data) <- network_vars

  analysis_weights <- as.numeric(
    stage2_data[[candidate_name]]
  )

  stopifnot(
    all(
      vapply(
        node_data,
        function(variable) {
          nlevels(variable) >= 2L
        },
        FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
      )
    ),
    all(
      is.finite(analysis_weights) &
        analysis_weights > 0
    )
  )

  lavaan_data <- node_data
  lavaan_data$analysis_weight <-
    analysis_weights

  lavaan_run <- run_and_capture(
    function() {
      lavaan::lavCor(
        object = lavaan_data,
        ordered = network_vars,
        sampling_weights = "analysis_weight",
        missing = "listwise",
        se = "none",
        test = "none",
        estimator = "two.step",
        baseline = FALSE,
        cor_smooth = FALSE,
        output = "cor"
      )
    }
  )

  lavaan_matrix <- if (
    is.null(lavaan_run$value)
  ) {
    NULL
  } else {
    as.matrix(lavaan_run$value)
  }

  if (!is.null(lavaan_matrix)) {
    dimnames(lavaan_matrix) <- list(
      network_vars,
      network_vars
    )
  }

  stage2_condition_records[[
    condition_index
  ]] <- data.frame(
    Election_year = stage2_year,
    Candidate = candidate_name,
    Implementation = "lavaan_lavCor",
    Pair = "FULL_MATRIX",
    Warning_count =
      length(lavaan_run$warnings),
    Warnings =
      collapse_conditions(
        lavaan_run$warnings
      ),
    Message_count =
      length(lavaan_run$messages),
    Messages =
      collapse_conditions(
        lavaan_run$messages
      ),
    Error = ifelse(
      is.na(lavaan_run$error),
      "",
      lavaan_run$error
    ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  condition_index <- condition_index + 1L

  wcorr_matrix <- diag(
    1,
    nrow = length(network_vars),
    ncol = length(network_vars)
  )

  dimnames(wcorr_matrix) <- list(
    network_vars,
    network_vars
  )

  for (
    first_index in
      seq_len(length(network_vars) - 1L)
  ) {
    for (
      second_index in
        seq.int(
          first_index + 1L,
          length(network_vars)
        )
    ) {
      first_node <-
        network_vars[first_index]

      second_node <-
        network_vars[second_index]

      pair_run <- run_and_capture(
        function() {
          wCorr::weightedCorr(
            x = node_data[[first_node]],
            y = node_data[[second_node]],
            method = "Polychoric",
            weights = analysis_weights,
            ML = FALSE,
            fast = TRUE
          )
        }
      )

      pair_value <- if (
        is.null(pair_run$value)
      ) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        as.numeric(pair_run$value)
      }

      wcorr_matrix[
        first_index,
        second_index
      ] <- pair_value

      wcorr_matrix[
        second_index,
        first_index
      ] <- pair_value

      stage2_condition_records[[
        condition_index
      ]] <- data.frame(
        Election_year = stage2_year,
        Candidate = candidate_name,
        Implementation =
          "wCorr_weightedCorr",
        Pair = paste(
          first_node,
          second_node,
          sep = " -- "
        ),
        Warning_count =
          length(pair_run$warnings),
        Warnings =
          collapse_conditions(
            pair_run$warnings
          ),
        Message_count =
          length(pair_run$messages),
        Messages =
          collapse_conditions(
            pair_run$messages
          ),
        Error = ifelse(
          is.na(pair_run$error),
          "",
          pair_run$error
        ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )

      condition_index <-
        condition_index + 1L
    }
  }

  stage2_results[[candidate_name]] <- list(
    lavaan = lavaan_matrix,
    wCorr = wcorr_matrix
  )
}

stage2_conditions <- do.call(
  rbind,
  stage2_condition_records
)
```

```{r stage2b-diagnostics-and-comparison}
compare_implementations <- function(
  candidate_name
) {
  lavaan_matrix <-
    stage2_results[[
      candidate_name
    ]]$lavaan

  wcorr_matrix <-
    stage2_results[[
      candidate_name
    ]]$wCorr

  matrices_available <-
    is.matrix(lavaan_matrix) &&
    is.matrix(wcorr_matrix) &&
    identical(
      dim(lavaan_matrix),
      c(9L, 9L)
    ) &&
    identical(
      dim(wcorr_matrix),
      c(9L, 9L)
    )

  if (!matrices_available) {
    return(
      data.frame(
        Election_year = stage2_year,
        Candidate = candidate_name,
        Compared_pairs = 0L,
        Correlation_between_estimates = NA_real_,
        Median_absolute_difference = NA_real_,
        Mean_absolute_difference = NA_real_,
        Maximum_absolute_difference = NA_real_,
        Maximum_difference_pair = NA_character_,
        Sign_agreement_proportion = NA_real_,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  pair_indices <- which(
    upper.tri(lavaan_matrix),
    arr.ind = TRUE
  )

  lavaan_values <-
    lavaan_matrix[pair_indices]

  wcorr_values <-
    wcorr_matrix[pair_indices]

  absolute_differences <- abs(
    lavaan_values -
      wcorr_values
  )

  maximum_index <- which.max(
    absolute_differences
  )

  pair_labels <- paste(
    rownames(lavaan_matrix)[
      pair_indices[, 1]
    ],
    colnames(lavaan_matrix)[
      pair_indices[, 2]
    ],
    sep = " -- "
  )

  data.frame(
    Election_year = stage2_year,
    Candidate = candidate_name,
    Compared_pairs =
      length(lavaan_values),
    Correlation_between_estimates =
      stats::cor(
        lavaan_values,
        wcorr_values
      ),
    Median_absolute_difference =
      stats::median(
        absolute_differences
      ),
    Mean_absolute_difference =
      mean(
        absolute_differences
      ),
    Maximum_absolute_difference =
      max(
        absolute_differences
      ),
    Maximum_difference_pair =
      pair_labels[maximum_index],
    Sign_agreement_proportion =
      mean(
        sign(lavaan_values) ==
          sign(wcorr_values)
      ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

stage2_comparison <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    stage2_candidates,
    compare_implementations
  )
)
```

## Hard stop after the 2004 Stage 2B pilot

Stop here. Do not extend the weighted-polychoric calculation to the other four waves and do not estimate EBICglasso until the 2004 implementation comparison, matrix diagnostics, warnings and errors have been independently reviewed.
## Stage 2C — Five-wave weighted-polychoric implementation check

This stage extends the validated 2004 implementation to the five approved overall waves. It remains a correlation-matrix diagnostic and does not estimate a network.

```{r stage2c-diagnostics}
diagnose_stage2c_matrix <- function(
  result,
  implementation
) {
  matrix_object <- result[[implementation]]

  matrix_present <-
    is.matrix(matrix_object) &&
    identical(
      dim(matrix_object),
      c(9L, 9L)
    )

  finite <- matrix_present &&
    all(is.finite(matrix_object))

  maximum_asymmetry <- if (finite) {
    max(
      abs(
        matrix_object -
          t(matrix_object)
      )
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  maximum_diagonal_difference <- if (finite) {
    max(
      abs(
        diag(matrix_object) - 1
      )
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  minimum_eigenvalue <- if (
    finite &&
    maximum_asymmetry <= 1e-10
  ) {
    tryCatch(
      min(
        eigen(
          matrix_object,
          symmetric = TRUE,
          only.values = TRUE
        )$values
      ),
      error = function(condition) {
        NA_real_
      }
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  data.frame(
    Election_year =
      result$Election_year,
    Candidate =
      result$Candidate,
    Sample_N =
      result$Sample_N,
    Implementation =
      implementation,
    Matrix_present =
      matrix_present,
    All_values_finite =
      finite,
    Maximum_asymmetry =
      maximum_asymmetry,
    Maximum_diagonal_difference =
      maximum_diagonal_difference,
    Minimum_eigenvalue =
      minimum_eigenvalue,
    Positive_definite =
      !is.na(minimum_eigenvalue) &&
      minimum_eigenvalue > 0,
    Unique_off_diagonal_values = if (
      finite
    ) {
      length(
        matrix_object[
          upper.tri(matrix_object)
        ]
      )
    } else {
      0L
    },
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

stage2c_diagnostics <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    stage2c_results,
    function(result) {
      rbind(
        diagnose_stage2c_matrix(
          result,
          "lavaan"
        ),
        diagnose_stage2c_matrix(
          result,
          "wCorr"
        )
      )
    }
  )
)

compare_stage2c_implementations <- function(
  result
) {
  lavaan_matrix <- result$lavaan
  wcorr_matrix <- result$wCorr

  available <-
    is.matrix(lavaan_matrix) &&
    is.matrix(wcorr_matrix) &&
    identical(
      dim(lavaan_matrix),
      c(9L, 9L)
    ) &&
    identical(
      dim(wcorr_matrix),
      c(9L, 9L)
    )

  if (!available) {
    return(
      data.frame(
        Election_year =
          result$Election_year,
        Candidate =
          result$Candidate,
        Compared_pairs = 0L,
        Correlation_between_estimates =
          NA_real_,
        Median_absolute_difference =
          NA_real_,
        Mean_absolute_difference =
          NA_real_,
        Maximum_absolute_difference =
          NA_real_,
        Maximum_difference_pair =
          NA_character_,
        Sign_agreement_proportion =
          NA_real_,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    )
  }

  pair_indices <- which(
    upper.tri(lavaan_matrix),
    arr.ind = TRUE
  )

  lavaan_values <-
    lavaan_matrix[pair_indices]

  wcorr_values <-
    wcorr_matrix[pair_indices]

  absolute_differences <- abs(
    lavaan_values -
      wcorr_values
  )

  pair_labels <- paste(
    rownames(lavaan_matrix)[
      pair_indices[, 1]
    ],
    colnames(lavaan_matrix)[
      pair_indices[, 2]
    ],
    sep = " -- "
  )

  maximum_index <- which.max(
    absolute_differences
  )

  data.frame(
    Election_year =
      result$Election_year,
    Candidate =
      result$Candidate,
    Compared_pairs =
      length(lavaan_values),
    Correlation_between_estimates =
      stats::cor(
        lavaan_values,
        wcorr_values
      ),
    Median_absolute_difference =
      stats::median(
        absolute_differences
      ),
    Mean_absolute_difference =
      mean(
        absolute_differences
      ),
    Maximum_absolute_difference =
      max(
        absolute_differences
      ),
    Maximum_difference_pair =
      pair_labels[maximum_index],
    Sign_agreement_proportion =
      mean(
        sign(lavaan_values) ==
          sign(wcorr_values)
      ),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

stage2c_comparison <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    stage2c_results,
    compare_stage2c_implementations
  )
)
```

```{r stage3a-2004-point-network-estimation}
stage3a_settings <- data.frame(
  Election_year = 2004L,
  Sample_N = 789L,
  Correlation = "polychoric",
  Estimator = "EBICglasso",
  Gamma = 0.50,
  Nlambda = 100L,
  Lambda_min_ratio = 0.01,
  Refit = FALSE,
  Threshold = FALSE,
  Weight_N_treatment = "raw complete-case N",
  Purpose = "diagnostic point-network comparison only",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stage3a_settings

run_stage3a_network <- function(
  correlation_matrix,
  candidate_name
) {
  model_run <- run_and_capture(
    function() {
      qgraph::EBICglasso(
        S = correlation_matrix,
        n = 789L,
        gamma = 0.50,
        nlambda = 100L,
        lambda.min.ratio = 0.01,
        refit = FALSE,
        threshold = FALSE
      )
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(model_run$value)) {
    dimnames(model_run$value) <- list(
      network_vars,
      network_vars
    )
  }

  list(
    Candidate = candidate_name,
    value = model_run$value,
    warnings = model_run$warnings,
    messages = model_run$messages,
    error = model_run$error
  )
}

stage3a_runs <- lapply(
  names(stage3a_input_matrices),
  function(candidate_name) {
    run_stage3a_network(
      correlation_matrix =
        stage3a_input_matrices[[candidate_name]],
      candidate_name = candidate_name
    )
  }
)

names(stage3a_runs) <-
  names(stage3a_input_matrices)

stage3a_conditions <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    stage3a_runs,
    function(model_run) {
      data.frame(
        Election_year = 2004L,
        Candidate = model_run$Candidate,
        Warning_count =
          length(model_run$warnings),
        Warnings =
          collapse_conditions(model_run$warnings),
        Message_count =
          length(model_run$messages),
        Messages =
          collapse_conditions(model_run$messages),
        Error = if (
          is.na(model_run$error)
        ) {
          ""
        } else {
          model_run$error
        },
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
)

stage3a_conditions_file <- file.path(
  pilot_table_dir,
  "d15_stage3a_2004_conditions.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  stage3a_conditions,
  stage3a_conditions_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

  stage3a_runs,
  function(model_run) {
    is.matrix(model_run$value) &&
      identical(
        dim(model_run$value),
        c(9L, 9L)
      ) &&
      (
        is.na(model_run$error) ||
          model_run$error == ""
      )
  },
  FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
)

if (!all(stage3a_success)) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Stage 3A network estimation failed.",
      "Inspect d15_stage3a_2004_conditions.csv."
    )
  )
}
```

```{r stage3a-2004-network-diagnostics}
extract_stage3a_edges <- function(network_matrix) {
  network_matrix[
    upper.tri(network_matrix)
  ]
}

stage3a_networks <- lapply(
  stage3a_runs,
  function(model_run) {
    model_run$value
  }
)

stage3a_network_diagnostics <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    names(stage3a_networks),
    function(candidate_name) {
      current_network <-
        stage3a_networks[[candidate_name]]

      current_edges <-
        extract_stage3a_edges(
          current_network
        )

      retained <- abs(current_edges) > 1e-12

      current_conditions <-
        stage3a_conditions[
          stage3a_conditions$Candidate ==
            candidate_name,
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ]

      data.frame(
        Election_year = 2004L,
        Candidate = candidate_name,
        Sample_N = 789L,
        Gamma = 0.50,
        Compared_edges = length(current_edges),
        Retained_edges = sum(retained),
        Density = sum(retained) /
          length(current_edges),
        Global_strength =
          sum(abs(current_edges)),
        Minimum_edge =
          min(current_edges),
        Maximum_edge =
          max(current_edges),
        All_values_finite =
          all(is.finite(current_network)),
        Maximum_asymmetry =
          max(
            abs(
              current_network -
                t(current_network)
            )
          ),
        Maximum_diagonal =
          max(abs(diag(current_network))),
        Warning_count =
          current_conditions$Warning_count,
        Error =
          current_conditions$Error,
        Network_SHA256 =
          digest::digest(
            current_network,
            algo = "sha256",
            serialize = TRUE
          ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
)

compare_stage3a_networks <- function(
  first_name,
  second_name
) {
  first_edges <- extract_stage3a_edges(
    stage3a_networks[[first_name]]
  )

  second_edges <- extract_stage3a_edges(
    stage3a_networks[[second_name]]
  )

  absolute_difference <-
    abs(first_edges - second_edges)

  first_retained <-
    abs(first_edges) > 1e-12

  second_retained <-
    abs(second_edges) > 1e-12

  retained_union <-
    first_retained | second_retained

  retained_intersection <-
    first_retained & second_retained

  sign_agreement_union <- if (
    sum(retained_union) > 0L
  ) {
    mean(
      sign(first_edges[retained_union]) ==
        sign(second_edges[retained_union])
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  edge_jaccard <- if (
    sum(retained_union) > 0L
  ) {
    sum(retained_intersection) /
      sum(retained_union)
  } else {
    1
  }

  data.frame(
    Election_year = 2004L,
    First_network = first_name,
    Second_network = second_name,
    Compared_edges = length(first_edges),
    Edge_weight_correlation =
      stats::cor(
        first_edges,
        second_edges
      ),
    Median_absolute_edge_difference =
      stats::median(absolute_difference),
    Mean_absolute_edge_difference =
      mean(absolute_difference),
    Maximum_absolute_edge_difference =
      max(absolute_difference),
    Sign_agreement_all_pairs =
      mean(
        sign(first_edges) ==
          sign(second_edges)
      ),
    Sign_agreement_retained_union =
      sign_agreement_union,
    Sign_reversals_among_common_edges =
      sum(
        first_edges[retained_intersection] *
          second_edges[retained_intersection] <
          0
      ),
    First_retained_edges =
      sum(first_retained),
    Second_retained_edges =
      sum(second_retained),
    Common_retained_edges =
      sum(retained_intersection),
    Retained_edge_union =
      sum(retained_union),
    Retained_edge_Jaccard =
      edge_jaccard,
    First_global_strength =
      sum(abs(first_edges)),
    Second_global_strength =
      sum(abs(second_edges)),
    Global_strength_difference =
      sum(abs(second_edges)) -
      sum(abs(first_edges)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

stage3a_comparison_pairs <- list(
  c("U_RAWN", "W_CDF_RAWN"),
  c("U_RAWN", "W_POST_COMPAT_RAWN"),
  c("W_CDF_RAWN", "W_POST_COMPAT_RAWN")
)

stage3a_network_comparison <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    stage3a_comparison_pairs,
    function(comparison_pair) {
      compare_stage3a_networks(
        first_name = comparison_pair[1],
        second_name = comparison_pair[2]
      )
    }
  )
)

stage07_reference_graph <- as.matrix(
  stage07_pilot$graph
)

stage07_reproduction_difference <- max(
  abs(
    stage3a_networks[["U_RAWN"]] -
      stage07_reference_graph
  )
)

stage3a_network_diagnostics
stage3a_network_comparison
stage07_reproduction_difference
```

## Stage 3B — Five-wave diagnostic point-network extension

Stage 3A passed independent review. This stage applies the identical
diagnostic EBICglasso specification to the five approved overall waves.
It compares unweighted, W_CDF and W_POST_COMPAT point networks without
selecting a final weight candidate. No bootstrap, centrality, NCT,
education-group analysis or political interpretation is performed.

```{r stage3b-five-wave-input-gate}
stage3b_required_packages <- c(
  "qgraph",
  "digest"
)

stage3b_package_gate <- data.frame(
  Package = stage3b_required_packages,
  Available = vapply(
    stage3b_required_packages,
    requireNamespace,
    quietly = TRUE,
    FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
  ),
  Version = vapply(
    stage3b_required_packages,
    function(package_name) {
      if (requireNamespace(package_name, quietly = TRUE)) {

            Sample_N[row_number],
        Rows = nrow(current_matrix),
        Columns = ncol(current_matrix),
        All_finite =
          all(is.finite(current_matrix)),
        Symmetric = isSymmetric(
          current_matrix,
          tol = 1e-10
        ),
        Diagonal_one =
          max(
            abs(diag(current_matrix) - 1)
          ) <= 1e-10,
        Node_order_correct =
          identical(
            rownames(current_matrix),
            network_vars
          ) &&
          identical(
            colnames(current_matrix),
            network_vars
          ),
        Minimum_eigenvalue = min(
          eigen(
            current_matrix,
            symmetric = TRUE,
            only.values = TRUE
          )$values
        ),
        Input_SHA256 = digest::digest(
          current_matrix,
          algo = "sha256",
          serialize = TRUE
        ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
)
```

```{r stage3b-five-wave-point-network-estimation}
run_stage3b_network <- function(
  correlation_matrix,
  year_value,
  candidate_name,
  sample_n
) {
  model_run <- run_and_capture(
    function() {
      qgraph::EBICglasso(
        S = correlation_matrix,
        n = sample_n,
        gamma = 0.50,
        nlambda = 100L,
        lambda.min.ratio = 0.01,
        refit = FALSE,
        threshold = FALSE
      )
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(model_run$value)) {
    dimnames(model_run$value) <- list(
      network_vars,
      network_vars
    )
  }

  list(
    Election_year = year_value,
    Candidate = candidate_name,
    Sample_N = sample_n,
    value = model_run$value,
    warnings = model_run$warnings,
    messages = model_run$messages,
    error = model_run$error
  )
}

stage3b_runs <- setNames(
  lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(stage3b_input_map)),
    function(row_number) {
      current_key <-
        stage3b_input_map$Key[row_number]

      run_stage3b_network(
        correlation_matrix =
          stage3b_input_matrices[[current_key]],
        year_value =
          stage3b_input_map$
            Election_year[row_number],
        candidate_name =
          stage3b_input_map$
            Candidate[row_number],
        sample_n =
          stage3b_input_map$
            Sample_N[row_number]
      )
    }
  ),
  stage3b_input_map$Key
)

stage3b_conditions <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    stage3b_runs,
    function(model_run) {
      data.frame(
        Election_year =
          model_run$Election_year,
        Candidate =
          model_run$Candidate,
        Sample_N =
          model_run$Sample_N,
        Warning_count =
          length(model_run$warnings),
        Warnings =
          collapse_conditions(
            model_run$warnings
          ),
        Message_count =
          length(model_run$messages),
        Messages =
          collapse_conditions(
            model_run$messages
          ),
        Error = if (
          is.na(model_run$error)
        ) {
          ""
        } else {
          model_run$error
        },
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
)

stage3b_conditions_file <- file.path(
  pilot_table_dir,
  "d15_stage3b_five_wave_conditions.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  stage3b_conditions,
  stage3b_conditions_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

stage3b_success <- vapply(
  stage3b_runs,
  function(model_run) {
    is.matrix(model_run$value) &&
      identical(
        dim(model_run$value),
        c(9L, 9L)
      ) &&
      (
        is.na(model_run$error) ||
          model_run$error == ""
      )
  },
  FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
)

if (!all(stage3b_success)) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Stage 3B network estimation failed.",
      "Inspect d15_stage3b_five_wave_conditions.csv."
    )
  )
}

stage3b_networks <- lapply(
  stage3b_runs,
  function(model_run) {
    model_run$value
  }
)

all_stage3b_warning_messages <- unlist(
  lapply(
    stage3b_runs,
    function(model_run) {
      model_run$warnings
    }
  ),
  use.names = FALSE
)

stage3b_only_expected_warnings <- if (
  length(all_stage3b_warning_messages) == 0L
) {
  TRUE
} else {
  all(
    grepl(
      "dense regularized network",
      tolower(all_stage3b_warning_messages),
      fixed = TRUE
    )
  )
}

stage3b_warning_classification <- if (
  length(all_stage3b_warning_messages) == 0L
) {
  "NO_WARNINGS"
} else if (
  stage3b_only_expected_warnings
) {
  "EXPECTED_DENSE_NETWORK_WARNINGS_ONLY"
} else {
  "UNEXPECTED_WARNING_PRESENT"
}
```

```{r stage3b-five-wave-network-diagnostics}
extract_stage3b_edges <- function(network_matrix) {
  network_matrix[
    upper.tri(network_matrix)
  ]
}

stage3b_network_diagnostics <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(stage3b_input_map)),
    function(row_number) {
      current_key <-
        stage3b_input_map$Key[row_number]

      current_network <-
        stage3b_networks[[current_key]]

      current_edges <-
        extract_stage3b_edges(
          current_network
        )

      retained_edges <-
        abs(current_edges) > 1e-12

      current_conditions <-
        stage3b_conditions[
          stage3b_conditions$Election_year ==
            stage3b_input_map$
              Election_year[row_number] &
            stage3b_conditions$Candidate ==
              stage3b_input_map$
                Candidate[row_number],
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ]

      current_input_check <-
        stage3b_input_checks[
          stage3b_input_checks$Key ==
            current_key,
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ]

      data.frame(
        Election_year =
          stage3b_input_map$
            Election_year[row_number],
        Candidate =
          stage3b_input_map$
            Candidate[row_number],
        Sample_N =
          stage3b_input_map$
            Sample_N[row_number],
        Gamma = 0.50,
        Compared_edges =
          length(current_edges),
        Retained_edges =
          sum(retained_edges),
        Density =
          sum(retained_edges) /
          length(current_edges),
        Global_strength =
          sum(abs(current_edges)),
        Minimum_edge =
          min(current_edges),
        Maximum_edge =
          max(current_edges),
        All_values_finite =
          all(is.finite(current_network)),
        Maximum_asymmetry =
          max(
            abs(
              current_network -
                t(current_network)
            )
          ),
        Maximum_diagonal =
          max(abs(diag(current_network))),
        Input_minimum_eigenvalue =
          current_input_check$
            Minimum_eigenvalue,
        Warning_count =
          current_conditions$
            Warning_count,
        Error =
          current_conditions$Error,
        Input_SHA256 =
          current_input_check$
            Input_SHA256,
        Network_SHA256 =
          digest::digest(
            current_network,
            algo = "sha256",
            serialize = TRUE
          ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
)

compare_stage3b_networks <- function(
  year_value,
  first_name,
  second_name
) {
  first_key <- paste(
    year_value,
    first_name,
    sep = "__"
  )

  second_key <- paste(
    year_value,
    second_name,
    sep = "__"
  )

  first_edges <- extract_stage3b_edges(
    stage3b_networks[[first_key]]
  )

  second_edges <- extract_stage3b_edges(
    stage3b_networks[[second_key]]
  )

  absolute_difference <-
    abs(first_edges - second_edges)

  first_retained <-
    abs(first_edges) > 1e-12

  second_retained <-
    abs(second_edges) > 1e-12

  retained_union <-
    first_retained | second_retained

  retained_intersection <-
    first_retained & second_retained

  sign_agreement_union <- if (
    sum(retained_union) > 0L
  ) {
    mean(
      sign(first_edges[retained_union]) ==
        sign(second_edges[retained_union])
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  edge_jaccard <- if (
    sum(retained_union) > 0L
  ) {
    sum(retained_intersection) /
      sum(retained_union)
  } else {
    1
  }

  data.frame(
    Election_year = year_value,
    First_network = first_name,
    Second_network = second_name,
    Compared_edges =
      length(first_edges),
    Edge_weight_correlation =
      stats::cor(
        first_edges,
        second_edges
      ),
    Median_absolute_edge_difference =
      stats::median(
        absolute_difference
      ),
    Mean_absolute_edge_difference =
      mean(absolute_difference),
    Maximum_absolute_edge_difference =
      max(absolute_difference),
    Sign_agreement_all_pairs =
      mean(
        sign(first_edges) ==
          sign(second_edges)
      ),
    Sign_agreement_retained_union =
      sign_agreement_union,
    Sign_reversals_among_common_edges =
      sum(
        first_edges[retained_intersection] *
          second_edges[retained_intersection] <
          0
      ),
    First_retained_edges =
      sum(first_retained),
    Second_retained_edges =
      sum(second_retained),
    Common_retained_edges =
      sum(retained_intersection),
    Retained_edge_union =
      sum(retained_union),
    Retained_edge_Jaccard =
      edge_jaccard,
    First_global_strength =
      sum(abs(first_edges)),
    Second_global_strength =
      sum(abs(second_edges)),
    Global_strength_difference =
      sum(abs(second_edges)) -
      sum(abs(first_edges)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

stage3b_comparison_design <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    stage3b_years,
    function(year_value) {
      data.frame(
        Election_year = year_value,
        First_network = c(
          "U_RAWN",
          "U_RAWN",
          "W_CDF_RAWN"
        ),
        Second_network = c(
          "W_CDF_RAWN",
          "W_POST_COMPAT_RAWN",
          "W_POST_COMPAT_RAWN"
        ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
)

stage3b_network_comparison <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    seq_len(
      nrow(stage3b_comparison_design)
    ),
    function(row_number) {
      compare_stage3b_networks(
        year_value =
          stage3b_comparison_design$
            Election_year[row_number],
        first_name =
          stage3b_comparison_design$
            First_network[row_number],
        second_name =
          stage3b_comparison_design$
            Second_network[row_number]
      )
    }
  )
)

stage3b_2004_reproduction <- data.frame(
  Candidate = stage3b_candidates,
  Maximum_absolute_difference = vapply(
    stage3b_candidates,
    function(candidate_name) {
      max(
        abs(
          stage3b_networks[[
            paste(
              2004L,
              candidate_name,
              sep = "__"
            )
          ]] -
            stage3a_saved$
              Point_networks[[
                candidate_name
              ]]
        )
      )
    },
    FUN.VALUE = numeric(1)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stage3b_maximum_2004_reproduction_difference <-
  max(
    stage3b_2004_reproduction$
      Maximum_absolute_difference
  )

stage3b_network_diagnostics
stage3b_network_comparison
stage3b_2004_reproduction
```

## Stage 3C — 2020 W_POST_COMPAT lambda-boundary diagnostic

This bounded diagnostic investigates the lowest-lambda boundary message
observed for the 2020 W_POST_COMPAT network. It compares the registered
lambda grid with a one-decade extension while keeping gamma and all other
estimation settings fixed. The extended grid is not a new primary model
and will not be selected automatically.

```{r stage3c-input-and-specification-gate}
stage3b_validation_path <- file.path(
  pilot_table_dir,
  "d15_stage3b_five_wave_validation.csv"
)

stage3b_conditions_path <- file.path(

  stage3b_conditions_path,
  stage3b_model_path

stopifnot(
  all(file.exists(stage3c_required_files)),
  requireNamespace("qgraph", quietly = TRUE),
  requireNamespace("digest", quietly = TRUE)

  stage3b_validation_path,

stage3b_conditions_disk <- utils::read.csv(

stage3b_saved <- readRDS(
  stage3b_model_path
)

stopifnot(
  nrow(stage3b_validation_disk) == 14L,
  all(as.logical(stage3b_validation_disk$Passed)),
  "2020__W_POST_COMPAT_RAWN" %in%
    names(stage3b_saved$Input_matrices),
  "2020__W_POST_COMPAT_RAWN" %in%
    names(stage3b_saved$Point_networks)
)

stage3c_previous_condition <-
  stage3b_conditions_disk[
    stage3b_conditions_disk$Election_year == 2020L &
      stage3b_conditions_disk$Candidate ==
        "W_POST_COMPAT_RAWN",
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

stage3c_previous_boundary_message <-
  nrow(stage3c_previous_condition) == 1L &&
  stage3c_previous_condition$Message_count == 1L &&
  grepl(
    "lowest lambda selected",
    tolower(stage3c_previous_condition$Messages),
    fixed = TRUE
  )

stopifnot(
  stage3c_previous_boundary_message
)

stage3c_input_matrix <- as.matrix(
  stage3b_saved$Input_matrices[[
    "2020__W_POST_COMPAT_RAWN"

stage3c_input_gate <- data.frame(
  Check = c(
    "Input matrix is 9 by 9",
    "All input values are finite",
    "Input matrix is symmetric",
    "Input diagonal equals one",
    "Node order is correct",
    "Input matrix is positive definite",
    "Reference network is 9 by 9",
    "Previous lowest-lambda message is documented"
  ),
  Passed = c(
    identical(
      dim(stage3c_input_matrix),
      c(9L, 9L)
    ),
    all(is.finite(stage3c_input_matrix)),
    isSymmetric(
      stage3c_input_matrix,
      tol = 1e-10
    ),
    max(
      abs(
        diag(stage3c_input_matrix) - 1
      )
    ) <= 1e-10,
    identical(
      rownames(stage3c_input_matrix),
      network_vars
    ) &&
      identical(
        colnames(stage3c_input_matrix),
        network_vars
      ),
    min(
      eigen(
        stage3c_input_matrix,
        symmetric = TRUE,
        only.values = TRUE
      )$values
    ) > 0,
    identical(
      dim(stage3c_reference_network),
      c(9L, 9L)
    ),
    stage3c_previous_boundary_message
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stage3c_input_gate

stopifnot(
```

```{r stage3c-run-lambda-paths}
run_stage3c_path <- function(
  specification_name,
  lambda_min_ratio,
  nlambda_value
) {
  path_run <- run_and_capture(
    function() {
      qgraph::EBICglasso(
        S = stage3c_input_matrix,
        n = 5390L,
        gamma = 0.50,
        nlambda = nlambda_value,
        lambda.min.ratio =
          lambda_min_ratio,
        refit = FALSE,
        threshold = FALSE,
        returnAllResults = TRUE
      )
    }
  )

  list(
    Specification =
      specification_name,
    Lambda_min_ratio =
      lambda_min_ratio,
    Nlambda =
      nlambda_value,
    value =
      path_run$value,
    warnings =
      path_run$warnings,
    messages =
      path_run$messages,
    error =
      path_run$error
  )
}

stage3c_path_runs <- setNames(
  lapply(
    seq_len(
      nrow(stage3c_specifications)
    ),
    function(row_number) {
      run_stage3c_path(
        specification_name =
          stage3c_specifications$
            Specification[row_number],
        lambda_min_ratio =
          stage3c_specifications$
            Lambda_min_ratio[row_number],
        nlambda_value =
          stage3c_specifications$
            Nlambda[row_number]
      )
    }
  ),
  stage3c_specifications$Specification
)

stage3c_conditions <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    stage3c_path_runs,
    function(path_run) {
      data.frame(
        Election_year = 2020L,
        Candidate =
          "W_POST_COMPAT_RAWN",
        Specification =
          path_run$Specification,
        Lambda_min_ratio =
          path_run$Lambda_min_ratio,
        Nlambda =
          path_run$Nlambda,
        Warning_count =
          length(path_run$warnings),
        Warnings =
          collapse_conditions(
            path_run$warnings
          ),
        Message_count =
          length(path_run$messages),
        Messages =
          collapse_conditions(
            path_run$messages
          ),
        Error = if (
          is.na(path_run$error)
        ) {
          ""
        } else {
          path_run$error
        },
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
)

stage3c_conditions_file <- file.path(
  pilot_table_dir,
  "d15_stage3c_2020_wpost_conditions.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  stage3c_conditions,
  stage3c_conditions_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

stage3c_success <- vapply(
  stage3c_path_runs,
  function(path_run) {
    !is.null(path_run$value) &&
      is.list(path_run$value) &&
      all(
        c(
          "ebic",
          "lambda",
          "optnet"
        ) %in%
          names(path_run$value)
      ) &&
      (
        is.na(path_run$error) ||
          path_run$error == ""
      )
  },
  FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
)

if (!all(stage3c_success)) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Stage 3C lambda-path estimation failed.",
      "Inspect d15_stage3c_2020_wpost_conditions.csv."
    )
  )
}

stage3c_selected_networks <- setNames(
  lapply(
    stage3c_path_runs,
    function(path_run) {
      selected_network <- as.matrix(
        path_run$value$optnet
      )

      dimnames(selected_network) <- list(
        network_vars,
        network_vars
      )

      selected_network
    }
  ),
  names(stage3c_path_runs)
)

all_stage3c_warning_messages <- unlist(
  lapply(
    stage3c_path_runs,
    function(path_run) {
      path_run$warnings
    }
  ),
  use.names = FALSE
)

all_stage3c_ordinary_messages <- unlist(
  lapply(
    stage3c_path_runs,
    function(path_run) {
      path_run$messages
    }
  ),
  use.names = FALSE
)

stage3c_only_expected_warnings <- if (
  length(all_stage3c_warning_messages) == 0L
) {
  TRUE
} else {
  all(
    grepl(
      "dense regularized network",
      tolower(
        all_stage3c_warning_messages
      ),

}

stage3c_only_expected_messages <- if (

) {

} else {
```

```{r stage3c-path-and-network-diagnostics}
extract_stage3c_edges <- function(network_matrix) {
  network_matrix[
    upper.tri(network_matrix)
  ]
}

stage3c_path_diagnostics <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    names(stage3c_path_runs),
    function(specification_name) {
      path_run <-
        stage3c_path_runs[[
          specification_name
        ]]

      path_result <- path_run$value

      selected_index <- which.min(
        path_result$ebic
      )

      selected_lambda <-
        path_result$lambda[
          selected_index
        ]

      lambda_maximum <- max(
        path_result$lambda
      )

      selected_network <-
        stage3c_selected_networks[[
          specification_name
        ]]

      selected_edges <-
        extract_stage3c_edges(
          selected_network
        )

      current_condition <-
        stage3c_conditions[
          stage3c_conditions$Specification ==
            specification_name,
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ]

      data.frame(
        Election_year = 2020L,
        Candidate =
          "W_POST_COMPAT_RAWN",
        Specification =
          specification_name,
        Lambda_min_ratio =
          path_run$Lambda_min_ratio,
        Nlambda =
          path_run$Nlambda,
        Selected_index =
          selected_index,
        Selected_lambda =
          selected_lambda,
        Lambda_maximum =
          lambda_maximum,
        Selected_lambda_ratio =
          selected_lambda /
          lambda_maximum,
        At_lower_boundary =
          selected_index == 1L,
        At_upper_boundary =
          selected_index ==
          length(path_result$lambda),
        Minimum_EBIC =
          min(path_result$ebic),
        EBIC_at_lower_boundary =
          path_result$ebic[1L],
        Lower_boundary_delta_EBIC =
          path_result$ebic[1L] -
          min(path_result$ebic),
        Selected_edges =
          sum(
            abs(selected_edges) >
              1e-12
          ),
        Density =
          sum(
            abs(selected_edges) >
              1e-12
          ) /
          length(selected_edges),
        Global_strength =
          sum(abs(selected_edges)),
        All_EBIC_values_finite =
          all(is.finite(path_result$ebic)),
        All_lambda_values_finite =
          all(is.finite(path_result$lambda)),
        Warning_count =
          current_condition$Warning_count,
        Message_count =
          current_condition$Message_count,
        Network_SHA256 =
          digest::digest(
            selected_network,
            algo = "sha256",
            serialize = TRUE
          ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
)

stage3c_full_path <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    names(stage3c_path_runs),
    function(specification_name) {
      path_run <-
        stage3c_path_runs[[
          specification_name
        ]]

      path_result <- path_run$value

      selected_index <- which.min(
        path_result$ebic
      )

      data.frame(
        Election_year = 2020L,
        Candidate =
          "W_POST_COMPAT_RAWN",
        Specification =
          specification_name,
        Grid_index =
          seq_along(path_result$lambda),
        Lambda =
          path_result$lambda,
        Lambda_ratio =
          path_result$lambda /
          max(path_result$lambda),
        EBIC =
          path_result$ebic,
        Selected =
          seq_along(path_result$lambda) ==
          selected_index,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
)

compare_stage3c_networks <- function(
  comparison_name,
  first_network,
  second_network
) {
  first_edges <-
    extract_stage3c_edges(
      first_network
    )

  second_edges <-
    extract_stage3c_edges(
      second_network
    )

  absolute_difference <-
    abs(first_edges - second_edges)

  first_retained <-
    abs(first_edges) > 1e-12

  second_retained <-
    abs(second_edges) > 1e-12

  retained_union <-
    first_retained | second_retained

  retained_intersection <-
    first_retained & second_retained

  data.frame(
    Election_year = 2020L,
    Candidate =
      "W_POST_COMPAT_RAWN",
    Comparison =
      comparison_name,
    Compared_edges =
      length(first_edges),
    Edge_weight_correlation =
      stats::cor(
        first_edges,
        second_edges
      ),
    Median_absolute_edge_difference =
      stats::median(
        absolute_difference
      ),
    Mean_absolute_edge_difference =
      mean(absolute_difference),
    Maximum_absolute_edge_difference =
      max(absolute_difference),
    First_retained_edges =
      sum(first_retained),
    Second_retained_edges =
      sum(second_retained),
    Common_retained_edges =
      sum(retained_intersection),
    Retained_edge_union =
      sum(retained_union),
    Retained_edge_Jaccard = if (
      sum(retained_union) > 0L
    ) {
      sum(retained_intersection) /
        sum(retained_union)
    } else {
      1
    },
    Sign_reversals_among_common_edges =
      sum(
        first_edges[retained_intersection] *
          second_edges[retained_intersection] <
          0
      ),
    First_global_strength =
      sum(abs(first_edges)),
    Second_global_strength =
      sum(abs(second_edges)),
    Global_strength_difference =
      sum(abs(second_edges)) -
      sum(abs(first_edges)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

stage3c_network_comparison <- rbind(
  compare_stage3c_networks(
    comparison_name =
      "STAGE3B_REFERENCE_VS_CURRENT_GRID",
    first_network =
      stage3c_reference_network,
    second_network =
      stage3c_selected_networks[[
        "CURRENT_GRID"
      ]]
  ),
  compare_stage3c_networks(
    comparison_name =
      "CURRENT_GRID_VS_EXTENDED_GRID",
    first_network =
      stage3c_selected_networks[[
        "CURRENT_GRID"
      ]],
    second_network =
      stage3c_selected_networks[[
        "EXTENDED_GRID"
      ]]
  )
)

stage3c_current_reproduction_difference <-
  max(
    abs(
      stage3c_reference_network -
        stage3c_selected_networks[[
          "CURRENT_GRID"
        ]]
    )
  )

stage3c_extended_row <-
  stage3c_path_diagnostics[
    stage3c_path_diagnostics$Specification ==
      "EXTENDED_GRID",
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

stage3c_boundary_status <- if (
  stage3c_extended_row$At_lower_boundary
) {
  "EXTENDED_GRID_REMAINS_AT_LOWER_BOUNDARY"
} else if (
  stage3c_extended_row$At_upper_boundary
) {
  "EXTENDED_GRID_SELECTED_UPPER_BOUNDARY"
} else {
  "EXTENDED_GRID_BRACKETED_INTERNAL_OPTIMUM"
}

stage3c_path_diagnostics
stage3c_network_comparison
stage3c_boundary_status
```

## Stage 3C independent-review disposition

Stage 3C passed independent review. The extended lambda path bracketed
an internal optimum, while the current-grid and extended-grid networks
were practically identical. The registered lambda grid is retained for
the remaining diagnostic stress test. This decision does not select a
final weight specification or authorise formal network analysis.
## Stage 3D — Kish effective-sample-size stress test

This diagnostic compares each weighted raw-N network with an otherwise
identical network in which rounded Kish effective sample size is supplied
to EBICglasso as n. Kish ESS is not treated as a validated or selectable
primary sample-size definition. No categorical materiality threshold is
introduced after inspecting the results.

```{r stage3d-kish-ess-input-gate}
stage3d_weight_audit_path <- file.path(
  pilot_table_dir,

stage3d_required_files <- c(

stopifnot(

)

stage3c_validation_disk <- utils::read.csv(

)

stage3b_saved <- readRDS(

stage3d_weight_audit <- utils::read.csv(

)

stage3d_weight_audit$Election_year <- as.integer(

)

stage3d_weight_audit$Complete_case_N <- as.integer(
  stage3d_weight_audit$Complete_case_N
)

stage3d_weight_audit$Kish_effective_N <- as.numeric(
  stage3d_weight_audit$Kish_effective_N
)

stopifnot(
```
