  all(as.logical(stage3b_validation_disk$Passed)),
  nrow(stage3c_validation_disk) == 15L,
  all(as.logical(stage3c_validation_disk$Passed))
)

stage3d_years <- c(
  2004L,
  2012L,
  2016L,
  2020L,
  2024L
)

stage3d_weight_candidates <- c(
  "W_CDF",
  "W_POST_COMPAT"
)

stage3d_input_map <- expand.grid(
  Election_year = stage3d_years,
  Weight_candidate = stage3d_weight_candidates,
  KEEP.OUT.ATTRS = FALSE,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stage3d_input_map$Raw_candidate <- ifelse(
  stage3d_input_map$Weight_candidate == "W_CDF",
  "W_CDF_RAWN",
  "W_POST_COMPAT_RAWN"
)

stage3d_input_map$Kish_candidate <- ifelse(
  stage3d_input_map$Weight_candidate == "W_CDF",
  "W_CDF_KISH",
  "W_POST_COMPAT_KISH"
)

stage3d_input_map$Raw_key <- paste(
  stage3d_input_map$Election_year,
  stage3d_input_map$Raw_candidate,
  sep = "__"
)

stage3d_input_map$Kish_key <- paste(
  stage3d_input_map$Election_year,
  stage3d_input_map$Kish_candidate,
  sep = "__"
)

get_stage3d_raw_n <- function(
  year_value,
  candidate_name
) {
  selected_row <- stage3b_saved$Settings[
    stage3b_saved$Settings$Election_year == year_value &
      stage3b_saved$Settings$Candidate == candidate_name,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (nrow(selected_row) != 1L) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "Stage 3D could not uniquely identify raw N for",
        year_value,
        candidate_name
      )
    )
  }

  as.numeric(selected_row$Sample_N)
}

get_stage3d_kish_ess <- function(
  year_value,
  weight_candidate
) {
  selected_row <- stage3d_weight_audit[
    stage3d_weight_audit$Election_year == year_value &
      stage3d_weight_audit$Candidate == weight_candidate,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (nrow(selected_row) != 1L) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "Stage 3D could not uniquely identify Kish ESS for",
        year_value,
        weight_candidate
      )
    )
  }

  as.numeric(selected_row$Kish_effective_N)
}

get_stage3d_complete_case_n <- function(
  year_value,
  weight_candidate
) {
  selected_row <- stage3d_weight_audit[
    stage3d_weight_audit$Election_year == year_value &
      stage3d_weight_audit$Candidate == weight_candidate,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

  if (nrow(selected_row) != 1L) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "Stage 3D could not uniquely identify complete-case N for",
        year_value,
        weight_candidate
      )
    )
  }

  as.integer(selected_row$Complete_case_N)
}

stage3d_input_map$Raw_N <- vapply(
  seq_len(nrow(stage3d_input_map)),
  function(row_number) {
    get_stage3d_raw_n(
      stage3d_input_map$Election_year[row_number],
      stage3d_input_map$Raw_candidate[row_number]
    )
  },
  FUN.VALUE = numeric(1)
)

stage3d_input_map$Audit_complete_case_N <- vapply(
  seq_len(nrow(stage3d_input_map)),
  function(row_number) {
    get_stage3d_complete_case_n(
      stage3d_input_map$Election_year[row_number],
      stage3d_input_map$Weight_candidate[row_number]
    )
  },
  FUN.VALUE = integer(1)
)

stage3d_input_map$Kish_effective_N_exact <- vapply(
  seq_len(nrow(stage3d_input_map)),
  function(row_number) {
    get_stage3d_kish_ess(
      stage3d_input_map$Election_year[row_number],
      stage3d_input_map$Weight_candidate[row_number]
    )
  },
  FUN.VALUE = numeric(1)
)

stage3d_input_map$Kish_N_supplied <- as.integer(
  round(
    stage3d_input_map$Kish_effective_N_exact
  )
)

stage3d_input_map$Kish_ESS_over_raw_N <-
  stage3d_input_map$Kish_effective_N_exact /
  stage3d_input_map$Raw_N

stopifnot(
  nrow(stage3d_input_map) == 10L,
  !anyDuplicated(stage3d_input_map$Kish_key),
  all(stage3d_input_map$Raw_N ==
        stage3d_input_map$Audit_complete_case_N),
  all(is.finite(
    stage3d_input_map$Kish_effective_N_exact
  )),
  all(stage3d_input_map$Kish_N_supplied > 0L),
  all(stage3d_input_map$Kish_N_supplied <=
        stage3d_input_map$Raw_N),
  all(stage3d_input_map$Raw_key %in%
        names(stage3b_saved$Input_matrices)),
  all(stage3d_input_map$Raw_key %in%
        names(stage3b_saved$Point_networks))
)

stage3d_input_matrices <- setNames(
  lapply(
    stage3d_input_map$Raw_key,
    function(current_key) {
      as.matrix(
        stage3b_saved$Input_matrices[[current_key]]
      )
    }
  ),
  stage3d_input_map$Kish_key
)

stage3d_input_checks <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(stage3d_input_map)),
    function(row_number) {
      current_key <-
        stage3d_input_map$Kish_key[row_number]

      current_matrix <-
        stage3d_input_matrices[[current_key]]

      data.frame(
        Election_year =
          stage3d_input_map$Election_year[row_number],
        Weight_candidate =
          stage3d_input_map$Weight_candidate[row_number],
        Kish_candidate =
          stage3d_input_map$Kish_candidate[row_number],
        Raw_N =
          stage3d_input_map$Raw_N[row_number],
        Kish_effective_N_exact =
          stage3d_input_map$
            Kish_effective_N_exact[row_number],
        Kish_N_supplied =
          stage3d_input_map$Kish_N_supplied[row_number],
        Rows = nrow(current_matrix),
        Columns = ncol(current_matrix),
        All_finite =
          all(is.finite(current_matrix)),
        Symmetric = isSymmetric(
          current_matrix,
          tol = 1e-10
        ),
        Diagonal_one =
          max(
            abs(diag(current_matrix) - 1)
          ) <= 1e-10,
        Node_order_correct =
          identical(
            rownames(current_matrix),
            network_vars
          ) &&
          identical(
            colnames(current_matrix),
            network_vars
          ),
        Minimum_eigenvalue = min(
          eigen(
            current_matrix,
            symmetric = TRUE,
            only.values = TRUE
          )$values
        ),
        Input_SHA256 = digest::digest(
          current_matrix,
          algo = "sha256",
          serialize = TRUE
        ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
)

stage3d_input_checks

stopifnot(
  nrow(stage3d_input_checks) == 10L,
  all(stage3d_input_checks$Rows == 9L),
  all(stage3d_input_checks$Columns == 9L),
  all(stage3d_input_checks$All_finite),
  all(stage3d_input_checks$Symmetric),
  all(stage3d_input_checks$Diagonal_one),
  all(stage3d_input_checks$Node_order_correct),
  all(stage3d_input_checks$Minimum_eigenvalue > 0)
)

stage3d_settings <- data.frame(

### 估计十张 Kish 网络

```{r stage3d-kish-ess-network-estimation}
run_stage3d_network <- function(
  correlation_matrix,
  year_value,
  weight_candidate,
  kish_candidate,
  raw_n,
  kish_ess_exact,
  kish_n
) {
  model_run <- run_and_capture(
    function() {
      qgraph::EBICglasso(
        S = correlation_matrix,
        n = kish_n,
        gamma = 0.50,
        nlambda = 100L,
        lambda.min.ratio = 0.01,
        refit = FALSE,
        threshold = FALSE
      )
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(model_run$value)) {
    dimnames(model_run$value) <- list(
      network_vars,
      network_vars
    )
  }

  list(
    Election_year = year_value,
    Weight_candidate = weight_candidate,
    Kish_candidate = kish_candidate,
    Raw_N = raw_n,
    Kish_effective_N_exact = kish_ess_exact,
    Kish_N_supplied = kish_n,
    value = model_run$value,
    warnings = model_run$warnings,
    messages = model_run$messages,
    error = model_run$error
  )
}

stage3d_runs <- setNames(
  lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(stage3d_input_map)),
    function(row_number) {
      current_key <-
        stage3d_input_map$Kish_key[row_number]

      run_stage3d_network(
        correlation_matrix =
          stage3d_input_matrices[[current_key]],
        year_value =
          stage3d_input_map$Election_year[row_number],
        weight_candidate =
          stage3d_input_map$Weight_candidate[row_number],
        kish_candidate =
          stage3d_input_map$Kish_candidate[row_number],
        raw_n =
          stage3d_input_map$Raw_N[row_number],
        kish_ess_exact =
          stage3d_input_map$
            Kish_effective_N_exact[row_number],
        kish_n =
          stage3d_input_map$Kish_N_supplied[row_number]
      )
    }
  ),
  stage3d_input_map$Kish_key
)

is_expected_stage3d_warning <- function(values) {
  if (length(values) == 0L) {
    logical(0)
  } else {
    grepl(
      "dense regularized network",
      tolower(values),
      fixed = TRUE
    )
  }
}

is_expected_stage3d_message <- function(values) {
  if (length(values) == 0L) {
    logical(0)
  } else {
    grepl(
      "network with lowest lambda selected",
      tolower(values),
      fixed = TRUE
    )
  }
}

stage3d_conditions <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    stage3d_runs,
    function(model_run) {
      expected_warning_flags <-
        is_expected_stage3d_warning(
          model_run$warnings
        )

      expected_message_flags <-
        is_expected_stage3d_message(
          model_run$messages
        )

      data.frame(
        Election_year =
          model_run$Election_year,
        Weight_candidate =
          model_run$Weight_candidate,
        Kish_candidate =
          model_run$Kish_candidate,
        Raw_N =
          model_run$Raw_N,
        Kish_effective_N_exact =
          model_run$Kish_effective_N_exact,
        Kish_N_supplied =
          model_run$Kish_N_supplied,
        Warning_count =
          length(model_run$warnings),
        Warnings =
          collapse_conditions(
            model_run$warnings
          ),
        Unexpected_warning_count =
          sum(!expected_warning_flags),
        Message_count =
          length(model_run$messages),
        Messages =
          collapse_conditions(
            model_run$messages
          ),
        Lowest_lambda_message =
          any(expected_message_flags),
        Unexpected_message_count =
          sum(!expected_message_flags),
        Error = if (
          is.na(model_run$error)
        ) {
          ""
        } else {
          model_run$error
        },
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
)

stage3d_conditions_file <- file.path(
  pilot_table_dir,
  "d15_stage3d_kish_ess_conditions.csv"
)

utils::write.csv(
  stage3d_conditions,
  stage3d_conditions_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

stage3d_success <- vapply(
  stage3d_runs,
  function(model_run) {
    is.matrix(model_run$value) &&
      identical(
        dim(model_run$value),
        c(9L, 9L)
      ) &&
      (
        is.na(model_run$error) ||
          model_run$error == ""
      )
  },
  FUN.VALUE = logical(1)
)

stage3d_conditions

if (!all(stage3d_success)) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Stage 3D network estimation failed.",
      "Inspect d15_stage3d_kish_ess_conditions.csv."
    )
  )
}

stage3d_networks <- lapply(
  stage3d_runs,
  function(model_run) {
    model_run$value
  }
)
```

### 比较 raw N 与 Kish ESS

```{r stage3d-kish-ess-diagnostics}
extract_stage3d_edges <- function(network_matrix) {
  network_matrix[
    upper.tri(network_matrix)
  ]
}

stage3d_network_diagnostics <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(stage3d_input_map)),
    function(row_number) {
      kish_key <-
        stage3d_input_map$Kish_key[row_number]

      current_network <-
        stage3d_networks[[kish_key]]

      current_edges <-
        extract_stage3d_edges(
          current_network
        )

      current_conditions <-
        stage3d_conditions[
          stage3d_conditions$Election_year ==
            stage3d_input_map$
              Election_year[row_number] &
            stage3d_conditions$Weight_candidate ==
              stage3d_input_map$
                Weight_candidate[row_number],
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ]

      current_input_check <-
        stage3d_input_checks[
          stage3d_input_checks$Election_year ==
            stage3d_input_map$
              Election_year[row_number] &
            stage3d_input_checks$Weight_candidate ==
              stage3d_input_map$
                Weight_candidate[row_number],
          ,
          drop = FALSE
        ]

      retained_edges <-
        abs(current_edges) > 1e-12

      data.frame(
        Election_year =
          stage3d_input_map$Election_year[row_number],
        Weight_candidate =
          stage3d_input_map$Weight_candidate[row_number],
        Kish_candidate =
          stage3d_input_map$Kish_candidate[row_number],
        Raw_N =
          stage3d_input_map$Raw_N[row_number],
        Kish_effective_N_exact =
          stage3d_input_map$
            Kish_effective_N_exact[row_number],
        Kish_N_supplied =
          stage3d_input_map$Kish_N_supplied[row_number],
        Kish_ESS_over_raw_N =
          stage3d_input_map$
            Kish_ESS_over_raw_N[row_number],
        Compared_edges =
          length(current_edges),
        Retained_edges =
          sum(retained_edges),
        Density =
          sum(retained_edges) /
          length(current_edges),
        Global_strength =
          sum(abs(current_edges)),
        Minimum_edge =
          min(current_edges),
        Maximum_edge =
          max(current_edges),
        All_values_finite =
          all(is.finite(current_network)),
        Maximum_asymmetry =
          max(
            abs(
              current_network -
                t(current_network)
            )
          ),
        Maximum_diagonal =
          max(abs(diag(current_network))),
        Input_minimum_eigenvalue =
          current_input_check$Minimum_eigenvalue,
        Warning_count =
          current_conditions$Warning_count,
        Lowest_lambda_message =
          current_conditions$Lowest_lambda_message,
        Error =
          current_conditions$Error,
        Input_SHA256 =
          current_input_check$Input_SHA256,
        Network_SHA256 = digest::digest(
          current_network,
          algo = "sha256",
          serialize = TRUE
        ),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
    }
  )
)

compare_stage3d_rawn_and_kish <- function(
  row_number
) {
  year_value <-
    stage3d_input_map$Election_year[row_number]

  weight_candidate <-
    stage3d_input_map$Weight_candidate[row_number]

  raw_key <-
    stage3d_input_map$Raw_key[row_number]

  kish_key <-
    stage3d_input_map$Kish_key[row_number]

  raw_network <- as.matrix(
    stage3b_saved$Point_networks[[raw_key]]
  )

  kish_network <- as.matrix(
    stage3d_networks[[kish_key]]
  )

  raw_edges <-
    extract_stage3d_edges(raw_network)

  kish_edges <-
    extract_stage3d_edges(kish_network)

  absolute_difference <-
    abs(raw_edges - kish_edges)

  raw_retained <-
    abs(raw_edges) > 1e-12

  kish_retained <-
    abs(kish_edges) > 1e-12

  retained_union <-
    raw_retained | kish_retained

  retained_intersection <-
    raw_retained & kish_retained

  retained_jaccard <- if (
    sum(retained_union) > 0L
  ) {
    sum(retained_intersection) /
      sum(retained_union)
  } else {
    1
  }

  sign_agreement_union <- if (
    sum(retained_union) > 0L
  ) {
    mean(
      sign(raw_edges[retained_union]) ==
        sign(kish_edges[retained_union])
    )
  } else {
    NA_real_
  }

  raw_global_strength <-
    sum(abs(raw_edges))

  kish_global_strength <-
    sum(abs(kish_edges))

  data.frame(
    Election_year = year_value,
    Weight_candidate = weight_candidate,
    Raw_candidate =
      stage3d_input_map$Raw_candidate[row_number],
    Kish_candidate =
      stage3d_input_map$Kish_candidate[row_number],
    Raw_N =
      stage3d_input_map$Raw_N[row_number],
    Kish_effective_N_exact =
      stage3d_input_map$
        Kish_effective_N_exact[row_number],
    Kish_N_supplied =
      stage3d_input_map$Kish_N_supplied[row_number],
    Kish_ESS_over_raw_N =
      stage3d_input_map$
        Kish_ESS_over_raw_N[row_number],
    Compared_edges =
      length(raw_edges),
    Edge_weight_correlation =
      stats::cor(raw_edges, kish_edges),
    Median_absolute_edge_difference =
      stats::median(absolute_difference),
    Mean_absolute_edge_difference =
      mean(absolute_difference),
    Maximum_absolute_edge_difference =
      max(absolute_difference),
    Sign_agreement_all_pairs =
      mean(
        sign(raw_edges) ==
          sign(kish_edges)
      ),
    Sign_agreement_retained_union =
      sign_agreement_union,
    Sign_reversals_among_common_edges =
      sum(
        raw_edges[retained_intersection] *
          kish_edges[retained_intersection] < 0
      ),
    Raw_retained_edges =
      sum(raw_retained),
    Kish_retained_edges =
      sum(kish_retained),
    Common_retained_edges =
      sum(retained_intersection),
    Retained_edge_union =
      sum(retained_union),
    Retained_edge_Jaccard =
      retained_jaccard,
    Raw_global_strength =
      raw_global_strength,
    Kish_global_strength =
      kish_global_strength,
    Global_strength_difference =
      kish_global_strength -
      raw_global_strength,
    Global_strength_percent_difference =
      if (raw_global_strength == 0) {
        NA_real_
      } else {
        100 *
          (
            kish_global_strength -
              raw_global_strength
          ) /
          raw_global_strength
      },
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

stage3d_network_comparison <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    seq_len(nrow(stage3d_input_map)),
    compare_stage3d_rawn_and_kish
  )
)

stage3d_network_diagnostics
stage3d_network_comparison
```

  Check = c(

    "Ten weighted Kish-ESS candidate records were mapped",

    "Rounded Kish N values are positive and do not exceed raw N",

    "All Kish-ESS network entries are finite",
    "All Kish-ESS networks are symmetric with zero diagonals",
    "Each Kish-ESS network contains 36 possible edges",
    "No estimation error was captured",
    "No unexpected estimation warning was captured",
    "No unexpected ordinary message was captured",
    "Ten raw-N versus Kish-ESS comparisons were produced",
    "The EBICglasso specification was held fixed",

    "No final weight or EBIC sample-size definition was selected"
  ),
  Passed = c(

      stage3d_input_map$Raw_N ==

    ),

    )) &&
      all(

      ),
    all(stage3d_input_map$Kish_N_supplied > 0L) &&

      ),
    nrow(stage3d_input_checks) == 10L &&

      all(stage3d_input_checks$Node_order_correct) &&
      all(

      ),
    length(stage3d_networks) == 10L &&
      all(stage3d_success),
    all(
      stage3d_network_diagnostics$
        All_values_finite
    ),
    all(
      stage3d_network_diagnostics$
        Maximum_asymmetry <= 1e-10
    ) &&
      all(
        stage3d_network_diagnostics$
          Maximum_diagonal <= 1e-10
      ),
    all(
      stage3d_network_diagnostics$
        Compared_edges == 36L
    ),
    all(stage3d_conditions$Error == ""),
    all(
      stage3d_conditions$
        Unexpected_warning_count == 0L
    ),
    all(
      stage3d_conditions$
        Unexpected_message_count == 0L
    ),
    nrow(stage3d_network_comparison) == 10L &&
      all(
        stage3d_network_comparison$
          Compared_edges == 36L
      ) &&
      all(is.finite(
        stage3d_network_comparison$
          Edge_weight_correlation
      )),
    all(stage3d_settings$Gamma == 0.50) &&
      all(stage3d_settings$Nlambda == 100L) &&
      all(
        stage3d_settings$
          Lambda_min_ratio == 0.01
      ) &&
      all(!stage3d_settings$Refit) &&
      all(!stage3d_settings$Threshold),
    TRUE,
    TRUE
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

stage3d_validation

stage3d_diagnostics_file <- file.path(
  pilot_table_dir,
  "d15_stage3d_kish_ess_point_network_diagnostics.csv"
)

stage3d_comparison_file <- file.path(
  pilot_table_dir,
  "d15_stage3d_rawn_vs_kish_comparison.csv"
)

stage3d_validation_file <- file.path(
  pilot_table_dir,
  "d15_stage3d_kish_ess_validation.csv"
)

stage3d_model_file <- file.path(
  stage2c_model_dir,
  "d15_stage3d_kish_ess_point_networks.rds"
)

stage3d_log_file <- file.path(
  pilot_log_dir,
  "06B_D15_stage3d_kish_ess.log"
)

stage3d_session_file <- file.path(
  pilot_log_dir,
  "06B_D15_stage3d_kish_ess_sessionInfo.txt"
)

utils::write.csv(
  stage3d_network_diagnostics,
  stage3d_diagnostics_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  stage3d_network_comparison,
  stage3d_comparison_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

utils::write.csv(
  stage3d_validation,
  stage3d_validation_file,
  row.names = FALSE
)

saveRDS(
  list(
    Settings = stage3d_settings,
    Input_map = stage3d_input_map,
    Input_checks = stage3d_input_checks,
    Input_matrices = stage3d_input_matrices,
    Kish_point_networks = stage3d_networks,
    Conditions = stage3d_conditions,
    Diagnostics = stage3d_network_diagnostics,
    RawN_vs_Kish_comparisons =
      stage3d_network_comparison
  ),
  stage3d_model_file
)

writeLines(
  capture.output(
    utils::sessionInfo()
  ),
  stage3d_session_file
)

writeLines(
  c(
    "D15 STAGE 3D — KISH EFFECTIVE-SAMPLE-SIZE STRESS TEST",
    paste0(
      "Timestamp: ",
      format(
        Sys.time(),
        "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S %z"
      )
    ),
    "Kish-ESS networks requested: 10",
    paste0(
      "Kish-ESS networks returned: ",
      sum(stage3d_success),
      "/10"
    ),
    paste0(
      "Lowest-lambda messages recorded: ",
      sum(
        stage3d_conditions$
          Lowest_lambda_message
      )
    ),
    paste0(
      "Unexpected warnings recorded: ",
      sum(
        stage3d_conditions$
          Unexpected_warning_count
      )
    ),
    paste0(
      "Unexpected messages recorded: ",
      sum(
        stage3d_conditions$
          Unexpected_message_count
      )
    ),
    paste0(
      "Errors recorded: ",
      sum(stage3d_conditions$Error != "")
    ),
    paste0(
      "Validation checks passed: ",
      sum(stage3d_validation$Passed),
      "/",
      nrow(stage3d_validation)
    ),
    "Kish ESS was used only as a diagnostic EBIC n stress test.",
    "No categorical materiality threshold was applied.",
    "No bootstrap, centrality, NCT or political interpretation was run.",
    "No final weight or EBIC sample-size definition was selected."
  ),
  stage3d_log_file
)

stage3d_output_files <- c(
  stage3d_conditions_file,
  stage3d_diagnostics_file,
  stage3d_comparison_file,
  stage3d_validation_file,
  stage3d_model_file,
  stage3d_log_file,
  stage3d_session_file
)

stopifnot(
  all(file.exists(stage3d_output_files))
)

data.frame(
  Output = stage3d_output_files,
  Exists = file.exists(stage3d_output_files),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

if (!all(stage3d_validation$Passed)) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "Stage 3D completed with a failed validation check.",
      "Inspect the saved Stage 3D files."
    )
  )
}
